title: The Young Woman Who Said Yes
reflectionQuestion: Has life ever asked something of you that didn't make sense at the time?
reflectionText: She was not chosen because she was powerful or important — she was a young woman in a small town, doing the kind of work no one writes about. And yet the question came to her. What is it to be asked something so large that no one would have prepared you for it — and to say yes, not because you understood, but because you were willing?

scriptureKeyVerse.text: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
